select (select count(distinct us.user_id) from sys_user_salary_scheme us where us.item_id = #{itemId}) as direct_user_count, (select count(distinct ur.user_id) from sys_role_salary_scheme rs join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rs.role_id where rs.item_id = #{itemId}) as role_inherited_user_count, (select count(distinct impacted.user_id) from ( select us.user_id from sys_user_salary_scheme us where us.item_id = #{itemId} union select ur.user_id from sys_role_salary_scheme rs join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rs.role_id where rs.item_id = #{itemId} ) impacted) as affected_user_count, (select count(distinct active_rows.user_id) from ( select us.user_id from sys_user_salary_scheme us where us.item_id = #{itemId} and us.status = '0' and (us.effective_date is null or us.effective_date = '' or us.effective_date <= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d')) and (us.end_date is null or us.end_date = '' or us.end_date >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d')) union select ur.user_id from sys_role_salary_scheme rs join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rs.role_id where rs.item_id = #{itemId} and (rs.effective_date is null or rs.effective_date = '' or rs.effective_date <= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d')) ) active_rows) as effective_now_count, (select count(distinct future_rows.user_id) from ( select us.user_id from sys_user_salary_scheme us where us.item_id = #{itemId} and us.status = '0' and us.effective_date > date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d') union select ur.user_id from sys_role_salary_scheme rs join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rs.role_id where rs.item_id = #{itemId} and rs.effective_date > date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d') ) future_rows) as future_effective_count, 0 as conflict_user_count
select count(distinct user_id) from sys_user_role where role_id = #{roleId}
